meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把技术性内容用大白话拆开，讲清楚其中的 who、what、where、why 和 when——也就是谁、什么、在哪、为什么、何时。
howto.when: 当你想让某个技术性内容用大白话讲清楚，并拆成 who、what、where、why、when 等几个方面时触发。

say.text: 用大白话拆一下这个，who、what、where 都讲清楚
say.note: Claude 会按这几点给出平实解释。

say.text: 这段技术说明太专业了，帮我用大白话讲一遍
say.note: 产出面向非技术读者的说明。

say.text: 把 X 按 who、what、why、when 拆给我听

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude breaks down technical material into plain English, covering the who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want something technical explained in plain English as a who, what, where, why, and when breakdown.

say_en.text: Break this down in plain English — cover the who, what, and where.
This tech doc is too jargon-heavy; explain it in plain English.
say_en.note: Output is written for non-technical readers.

say_en.text: Walk me through X by who, what, why, and when.
say_en.note: It goes through each of those angles.
